summary: This directory contains internal utilities for analyzing package structures, resolving export targets, and managing project-wide package concepts. It provides the core data processing layer for discovering source files and defining the exported interface of a project.
responsibilities: Analyze project package exports and their associated source files
Resolve package export targets to concrete source file paths
Serialize and persist package conceptual models to the file system
Provide type definitions for package analysis results
relationships: Package export analysis utilizes resolved source files to generate a comprehensive report of exported symbols.
The resolution of package export targets provides the necessary paths to identify and analyze relevant source files.
Package concepts are persisted to and loaded from the file system to provide a conceptual overview of the package structure.
Dependency collection informs the overall analysis by identifying the external requirements defined in the project configuration.
designDecisions: Strict separation of concern between export resolution and conceptual reporting
Schema-based validation for loading and saving package concepts
Centralized type definitions for shared analysis data structures
Internal visibility to encapsulate logic from public package APIs
